name: Dynamic Boundary Projection Algorithm (DBPA) Voxel Removal and Mesh Update
aliases: DBPA Voxel Removal and Mesh Update
definition: A method for maintaining a triangle mesh representation of a voxel set during carving. When a voxel is removed, the mesh is updated to reflect the new surface, preserving the 'BPA front invariant property' by managing loops of edges and using a 'glue' operation to remove undesirable adjacent edges.
summary: DBPA Voxel Removal and Mesh Update incrementally updates triangle meshes during volume carving, preserving smooth visualization and avoiding global remeshing costs by maintaining the BPA front invariant property.
